anya: heads-up: while onboarding deepprime-13b-q4 we saw divergence after long prefill (~12k tokens). outputs start matching then drift around token 8192. looks like a RoPE scaling/threshold issue :thinking_face:
liam: ack. do we have a minimal repro? can you paste the invocation?
anya: repro cmd i used:
```
python -m tests.kv_repro --model deepprime-13b-q4 --prefill 12000 --seed 42 --stream false
```
logs/snippet:
```
[2026-02-12 14:03:12] prefill: 12000 tokens
[2026-02-12 14:03:12] kv-window: 16384, shard=0
[2026-02-12 14:03:18] token=8191 -> logits OK
[2026-02-12 14:03:18] token=8192 -> logits diverged (KL 1.23)
```
liam: interesting. token 8192 is the boundary we keep seeing. could be a sign/scale mismatch in the rotary implementation used during quant conversion. did conversion set any rope_scale override?
anya: conversion config shows `rope_scale: 0.5` but runtime default is `1.0`. i think converter baked a scale for long-context math but runtime isn't applying it.
devon: that smells like the quant convert script applied legacy scaling for older RoPE paramization. we switched to normalized RoPE in the runtime last quarter. probable mismatch: converter expects "attn_rotary_scaling=true" but model runtime uses normalized phase.
marta: also check quantization: int4 packer in converter was dropping small sign-bit adjustments on layernorm prehooks once sequence >8k in our earlier bug. could compound the rotation mismatch.
liam: i'll run an A/B: (a) force runtime `rope_scale=0.5` via env override, (b) run convert->float16 instead of int4 packer to isolate q error.
ci-bot: test-run started: kv-repro/deepprime-13b-q4/1714567890 (this will spin up a worker and post status) :gear:
liam: quick diff from run (override rope_scale=0.5):
```
-- token 8192: baseline logits vs override logits: KL=0.02
-- token 8192: override matches fp16-run; no divergence observed
```
liam: FP16 convert (no int4) still diverged when runtime rope_scale=1.0 -> so conversion scale is the root cause.
anya: good catch. so immediate mitigation is to allow a runtime override for `rope_scale` per model and document it for onboarding. create a conversion fix for the packer after.
devon: i'll PR a converter flag `--export-rope-scale` and add an assert in the model-config json to include `rope_scale` metadata.
marta: file a regression ticket and mark for hotfix if customers use longprefill. tags: @prod, @oncall.
anya: created ticket INC-2345 and pinned logs + reproduce steps. assigning to @devon for converter fix and @liam for runtime override API.
liam: timeline: i'll push runtime override by EOD, run full smoke with generate-stream and sampling, then update the model catalog entry with `rope_scale` hint.
ci-bot: test-run complete: green for rope_scale override experiments. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/deepprime-13b-q4/1714567890/report.html
anya: summary: root cause = mismatch between converter-exported RoPE scaling and runtime default. mitigation = runtime per-model `rope_scale` override + fix converter to embed scale into model metadata. follow-ups: quant packer audit for sign-bit loss on long-prefill. :white_check_mark:
